text:
jen: FYI customer asked for a fast opt-in into an edge routing canary for ~12 tenants. asks: per-tenant opt-in/skiplist, A/B on prompt templates, and a tighter rollback window. scope minimal?
ajay: clarify: region-based edge routing vs dedicated edge nodes? changes routing policy.
rachel: they want region-level edge routing to avoid extra hop; need routing rule and fallback to regional pools.
sree: risks: cold KV cache, telemetry blindspots on new slice, token spend spike if sampling too high.
carl: ops needs per-tenant kill-switch + global breaker + embedding quota guard.
jen: propose minimal launch: per-tenant skiplist customer-managed, 5% sampling to prompt-B, per-tenant kill-switch endpoint with reason logging, telemetry hooks (95p latency, token delta, small eval).
ajay: quick config sketch: `flag=edge_fast_opt_v1; rules: if tenant in ["z-100","z-101"] then route=edge; if tenant in skiplist then route=regional; sampling=0.05; kill_switch=POST /api/flags/edge_fast_opt_v1/kill; approval_endpoint=POST /api/flags/edge_fast_opt_v1/approve`
rachel: start 5% then ramp 5->20->50 over 24h with telemetry gates and manual approval option for "fast-opt". add checks at each step: 95p latency, tokens/req, prompt-quality.
sree: telemetry: run lightweight eval on first 500 responses per tenant; if quality drops >3% auto-fallback. add KV warmup TTL + background priming job.
carl: cost gating: if token spend >2x baseline in first 2h -> reduce sampling to 1% or disable; alert SRE on-call. require per-tenant debug logs ON for first 6h.
jen: allow "fast-opt" only with SRE on-call and manual approvals at each ramp step for first hour. tradeoff reduces blast radius.
ajay: manual approval flow doable; deploy-bot timestamps approvals.
deploy-bot: approval requested by jen for z-100 fast-opt. status: pending.
rachel: ops checklist for fast-opt: 1) add tenants to skiplist 2) enable sampling 5% 3) start KV warmup 4) attach telemetry dashboard+alerts 5) SRE approve -> continue ramp.
sree: fallback hierarchy: primary -> regional model variant; secondary -> quantized cheaper variant + notify customer; final -> 503 with graceful message and incident ticket. auto-fallback triggers: quality_drop>3% OR token_delta>2x OR latency_95p> SLA.
carl: add reason tag on kill-switch and short TTL for warmup priming to avoid stale prefixes.
jen: owners: @ajay implement kill-switch+approval endpoint (ETA 3h); @rachel create dashboard+eval job (ETA 6h); @sree draft auto-fallback rules (ETA EOD). i'll coordinate with customer ops and SRE. reconvene in #product in 6h for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
